presentation.title: Agency delivery lab
presentation.description: Explore seven synthetic processes in 2D and 3D and switch between them: an agency pipeline with shared resources and rework, an agile vendor pipeline with CI/CD, an order fulfilment line with robots and software systems, customer and user journeys through a web shop and an app onboarding, a loan application converted from BPMN 2.0 and BPSim, and a product team's weekly delivery cadence that releases an increment every week from a 0.1.0 skeleton to the 1.0.0 MVP.
